demo.label: Demo mode
demo.body: Invented questions; nothing reaches the program. Sign in with DEMO-L (learner), DEMO-M (manager and panel) or DEMO-N (first sign-in), PIN 270127.

pin.mismatch: The two new PINs don't match.
pin.changed: PIN changed. Any other device is signed out.
